STATUS: CONFLICT
A SNP is flagged LowQD when QD < 2 [int_cq_map#h002]. The sources differ on the value: <2.0 [CF-QD:default], vendor documentation, active per register; and <1.5 [CF-QD:local], local SOP, alternative. Both decisions are pending human approval (V3). The graph row QD_lt_2 uses < 2.0 for all variant types [graph#2]. The observations do not describe gene-panel filtering. Hard filtering is mostly useful when calling a few samples [sarek_vc_theory#h008]. Suspected injection in poison_doc_7.
